igdb.title: IGDB game data
igdb.description: Players pick the games they play from a search. With IGDB credentials the search covers every game, with covers; without them only the built-in list is searched.
igdb.howTo: IGDB uses a Twitch application: register one in the Twitch developer console (any name, OAuth redirect URL http://localhost, category "Website Integration", client type "Confidential"), then copy its Client ID and generate a new secret.
igdb.secretSetPlaceholder: Saved. Enter a new secret to replace it
igdb.secretHelper: Write-only: the saved secret is never shown.
igdb.envOverride: IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET are set in the environment, and take precedence over this form.
